units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 22:28">Targ. Y. Lev. XXII, 28</cite> (not <cite ref="T00527"><he>רחמין</he></cite>, v. infra).
Targ. Y. Num. XII, 13; a. e.—Esp. רחמנא the Merciful, God.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 112:4">Targ. Ps. CXII, 4</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:6">Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 6</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ top (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 22:28">Lev. XXII, 28</cite>) <he>אילין דמתרגמין … כמא דאנא ר׳ … כך תהוון רחמנין וכ׳</he> those who in the interpretation of this verse say, my people, as I am merciful in heaven, so shall you be merciful: cow or ewe &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:10:3">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> top <he>דאנן רחמין</he> (corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:9">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> <he>בריך ר׳ דלית וכ׳</he> blessed be the Lord that I have neither father nor mother (because it is so difficult to do one’s duty by one’s parents); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:25">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot.
Taan. 9ᵇ ר׳ ליצלן וכ׳ the Lord save us &c., v. כִּיסּוּפָא; a. fr.—Trnsf. the Word of God, Scripture, the Law.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a:17">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>דרמיא ר׳ שבועה וכ׳</he> the Law imposes an oath upon him.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3b:1">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>ואמר ר׳ רמי וכ׳</he> and the Law says, impose an oath upon him.

<cite ref="Keritot 7a:6-21">Ker. 7ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:12">Lev. XXI, 12</cite>) <he>שמן … קרייה ר׳ וכ׳</he> the Scripture calls it oil of ordination (sacred) to intimate, that it does not lose its sacred character even after being put on his head; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="T00532"><he>רַחֲמָנִין</he></cite>. Targ. Y. Lev. l. c.—Y. Ber. l. c.; Y. Meg. l. c.; a. e.—[Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ bot. <he>הוו רחמנא</he>, v. <cite ref="T00517"><he>רְחֵם</he></cite>.]
